title: Menu holder refactor and GUI lifecycle improvements
summary: Since de29c7dd, Plugin Engine refactored menu holder internals and inventory interaction flow to improve GUI behavior and lifecycle safety.
body:
## Changed
- Revamped chest, hopper, paginated, and base UI holder flow to use dedicated InteractiveMenuHolder implementations and cleaner inventory routing
- Removed holder cache usage and updated inventory controller/menu interaction internals for safer menu lifecycle handling

## Added
- Dedicated menu holder classes for chest, hopper, and paginated menus to improve separation of concerns in GUI internals
- Clearer interactive menu holder abstractions used by chest, hopper, and paginated menu implementations
